system.description:
Your reflexes are so finely developed that you respond to another's actions even as he begins to move, striking before he can complete his intent.

By expending a Blood Trait you preempt any physical action you are aware of that takes place in the turn; should a yeoman abruptly switch from parley to impaling you with his spear, you may choose to attack him first. The power gives no aid against actions you cannot perceive, such as an unannounced longbow shot. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability, though actions performed under it may be retested normally; a character caught by surprise cannot use Celerity on the first challenge. Where two speed-users vie for the same benefit, the one with the higher Celerity acts first. The effect lasts one turn.
